facts.name: The Peach Bucket

observations.status: public marketing assertions, not independently verified product safety evidence
observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

facts.constraints: Availability unknown: no scarcity. Policy eligibility details not supplied; do not expand policies. Adult supervision remains necessary. These are saved website observations, not a fresh website check.
facts.visual_brief: Same assumed creative for every condition: product-kit photograph on a plain cream background. No image is supplied to the model; do not claim to inspect a photograph.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent who has already seen the Peach Bucket kit and wants to know what help is available if they get stuck with installation. Answer that buying question directly using the supplied support claim. Do not make up support hours, appointment availability, tools or setup time. This is a hypothetical retargeting brief, not observed campaign data.

variants.concept: Getting stuck on an edge protector
variants.primary_text: Unsure where an edge protector goes? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support, so you have a way to get guidance while working through the kit. If an installation step leaves you unsure, that support is part of the offer—not something you have to guess about from the product photo. Explore the kit when you're ready.
variants.headline: Installation questions? 1-to-1 video support

variants.concept: Wanting guidance with a cabinet or fridge lock
variants.primary_text: Wondering how to approach a cabinet or fridge lock? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support. If you hit a sticking point, you have an option for installation guidance rather than being left with the question of where to turn. See the kit details and decide if it suits your home.
variants.headline: Help with kit installation, one-to-one

variants.primary_text: Before choosing a child-safety kit, it’s fair to wonder what happens if an installation step isn’t clear. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support, so installation guidance is part of the offer. Take a look at the kit details, including the support, and decide whether it’s the help you’re looking for.
variants.headline: Know what installation support is included

output.internal_notes: The 1-to-1 installation video support is a supplied public marketing claim, not independently verified. Copy does not promise support hours, appointment availability, setup time, or a guaranteed installation outcome.
